latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Running Training Coach skill.

- Guides users to create personalized, progressive running plans for races, general fitness, or habit building.
- Covers all levels, from beginners (e.g. couch to 5K) to advanced runners.
- Provides structured weekly schedules, pace guidance, and safe progression (follows the 10% rule).
- Includes tips for race-week taper, race-day strategy, and recovery.
- Enforces clear safety boundaries: does not give medical advice or replace certified professionals.
- Requires key user inputs (goal, mileage, days per week, experience, injuries) and adapts plans with user feedback.
